facts.fact: The launch of generalisation of the Référentiel national d'adressage in Timimoun, the first of six wilayas programmed for 2026, with over 110 million dinars allocated, was announced by the head of the national addressing commission to the APS.
The pilot phase in Alger, Oran, Constantine, Ouargla, Bouira and Sidi Bel-Abbès established over 1.1 million official, geolocated, harmonised addresses nationally, per the same APS statement.
